builds.name: Reference: Mana burn zones
builds.goal: Reference for Aurelion Sol: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A scaling zone mage who collects Stardust through sustained beam contact and enemies inside Singularity, then follows retreating fights with flight. Fix finite Stardust and measure beam hold time, Singularity occupancy and safe flight access. Do not invent arbitrary stack totals to prove an item route. Mana and repeated ability damage may maintain burns and MR-reduction stacks.
builds.summary: Mana and repeated ability damage may maintain burns and MR-reduction stacks.
testPlan: Kit question for Aurelion Sol: Fix finite Stardust and measure beam hold time, Singularity occupancy and safe flight access. Do not invent arbitrary stack totals to prove an item route.

Start with the early core (Blackfire Torch, then Liandry) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Mana and repeated ability damage may maintain burns and MR-reduction stacks. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Aurelion Sol channels his dragon breath for a few seconds, damaging the first enemy hit and splashing reduced damage onto nearby enemies. Each second the breath is channeled directly at an enemy will deal bonus damage, which is improved by the amount of Stardust that's been collected. This ability collects Stardust if the target is a champion. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Burn refresh is not unlimited independent stacking; measure target contact and debuff ramp.

The route fails Aurelion Sol's stated kit question: Fix finite Stardust and measure beam hold time, Singularity occupancy and safe flight access. Do not invent arbitrary stack totals to prove an item route.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Burn refresh is not unlimited independent stacking; measure target contact and debuff ramp.
Full cost 15,650 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Blackfire Torch, then Liandry. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Bloodletter's Curse, Zhonya's Hourglass are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Aurelion Sol breathes starfire for up to [3.25 / 3.25 / 3.25 / 3.25 / 9999] seconds, dealing [45 / 60 / 75 / 90 / 105 + (0.55) × AP] magic damage per second to the first enemy hit and [50]% of the damage to surrounding enemies.

Each full second of breath on the same enemy deals a burst of [60 / 70 / 80 / 90 / 100 + (0.3) × AP] magic damage plus [(0.00031) × BuffStacks({c9372c6b})] max Health magic damage and absorbs [2] Stardust if they are a champion.

Aurelion Sol plucks a star from the heavens and crashes it into the earth, dealing [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.75) × AP] magic damage, Stunning enemies [1] second, and absorbing [5] Stardust for each champion hit.

Gathering [75] Stardust transforms the next {{Spell_AurelionSolR1_Name}} into {{Spell_AurelionSolR2_Name}}.

{{Spell_AurelionSolR2_Name}}: Aurelion Sol drags a constellation's worth of fury down from the cosmos, dealing [(150 / 250 / 350 + (0.75) × AP) × (1.25)] magic damage in a larger area, Knocking Up enemies hit for [1] second, and unleashing a massive shockwave that deals [(150 / 250 / 350 + (0.75) × AP) × (0.9)] magic damage to champions and Epic Monsters and Slows all enemies hit by [50]% for 1 second.

Aurelion Sol summons a black hole, dealing [10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 + (0.12) × AP] magic damage per second and Dragging enemies towards the center for [5] seconds. Enemies in the center below [5 + (0.026) × BuffStacks({c9372c6b})]% max Health die instantly.

The black hole absorbs Stardust when enemies die within it and each second an enemy champion is inside.

Aurelion Sol's damaging Abilities break down enemies into Stardust, which improves his Abilities.{{Spell_AurelionSolQ_Name}}: Bursts deal an additional [(0.00031) × BuffStacks({c9372c6b})] max Health magic damage{{Spell_AurelionSolW_Name}}: @f2.1@% increased distance.{{Spell_AurelionSolE_Name}}: @f3.1@% increased area and [(0.026) × BuffStacks({c9372c6b})] bonus execute threshold.{{Spell_AurelionSolR1_Name}} and {{Spell_AurelionSolR2_Name}}: @f4.1@% increased area.
Aurelion Sol has acquired Stardust: @f1@

Aurelion Sol flies in a direction. While flying, {{Spell_AurelionSolQ_Name}} has no Cooldown, no max channel duration, and its flat damage is increased by [(0.08 / 0.09 / 0.1 / 0.11 / 0.12) × 100]%.

Takedowns on champions within [3] seconds of damaging them refunds [90]% of this Ability's Cooldown.

builds.name: Flight Beam Lock
builds.summary: Count full-second bursts during moving flight.
builds.goal: Count full-second bursts during moving flight.
builds.hypothesis: Q bursts require a full second on one enemy. W removes Q cooldown/channel cap during flight; Rylai may retain the enemy, Cosmic assists movement and Seraph provides finite mana. Riftmaker rewards actual sustained combat.
testPlan: Required state: Record Stardust, mana and a flight path allowing repeated full-second hits. Earn Seraph transformation through recorded Tear stacks before using this six-slot state.
Count full-second bursts during moving flight; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Control interrupts Q or flight carries him away.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: 9999 channel duration does not mean infinite mana.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Cosmic Drive, Seraph's Embrace, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Singularity Ally Window
builds.summary: Compare allied damage after R against E alone.
builds.goal: Compare allied damage after R against E alone.
builds.hypothesis: E drags and has a Stardust execute; R stuns or knocks up. Mandate explicitly requires immobilization, so use R as its trigger. Blackfire rewards enemies actually burned and Cryptbloom rewards a real confinement takedown.
testPlan: Required state: Record enhanced R readiness and finite Stardust; allies hit the mark.
Compare allied damage after R against E alone; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Targets leave E or allies cannot exploit R.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: An E drag or Rylai slow is not proven to trigger Mandate.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Imperial Mandate, Blackfire Torch, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Cryptbloom, Rabadon's Deathcap, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
